# Cubby (gotcubby.com)

> Cubby is a privacy-first iOS inventory app for bins, pantries, and garages:
> NFC/QR-tagged bins, on-device Vision item recognition, optional opt-in iCloud
> sync (private database only). No accounts, no cloud backend, no telemetry.

## Engineering

- [SwiftData + CloudKit in production: the sharp edges Apple doesn't document](https://gotcubby.com/swiftdata-cloudkit-production.html):
  Production postmortem. Key findings, all incident-verified: (1) CD_moveReceipt
  and CD_entityName are framework-injected serializer fields — expected on every
  record type, safe to deploy, never name @Model properties after them;
  (2) the sync MODE, not the iCloud entitlement, decides whether data leaves the
  device — pass cloudKitDatabase: .none explicitly everywhere sync is off,
  including tests and previews; (3) CloudKit record-type schema materializes
  lazily on first sync, so a clean Development↔Production diff can hide entirely
  undeployed types — verify coverage against the app's registered-type list;
  (4) force-materialize schema with a DEBUG-only initializeCloudKitSchema bridge
  over a transient NSPersistentCloudKitContainer; (5) gate releases on an
  automated cktool schema-verification script whenever the diff touches a model;
  (6) "CKErrorDomain error 2" is partialFailure wrapped generically — diagnose
  with -com.apple.CoreData.CloudKitDebug 3; (7) CloudKit Production schema is
  add-only and permanent; (8) never rename both ends of a shipped many-to-many
  (lightweight migration loses the join rows' reconstruction anchor).
  Includes the full verify-cloudkit-schema.sh release-gate script.
